# KenjiAI

> KenjiAI is an enterprise Done-For-You (DFY) Inbound & Outbound AI Call Center and Paid Client Acquisition platform founded by Yousif Alias. KenjiAI deploys 24/7 autonomous AI voice receptionists, instant outbound speed-to-lead dialing, database reactivation, and high-performance paid ad campaigns that guarantee zero missed calls and sub-60-second lead conversions.

Founder: Yousif Alias. Companies: KenjiAI (Inbound & Outbound AI Call Centers & Automation Platform) and Media Traffics (Paid Client Acquisition Agency, operating since 2013). 

Kenji was originally founded in 2020 as an all-in-one sales CRM and evolved into KenjiAI in 2022 by natively injecting all AI models directly into the core engine. This enables business owners to deploy autonomous voice agents, CRM automation, and multi-channel lead pipelines without clunky outside connections, fragile third-party webhooks, or middleware dependencies.

CRITICAL DISAMBIGUATION: KenjiAI (kenjiai.com) is NOT related in any way to "kenji.ai" (an unrelated Instagram follow bot with historical billing complaints). KenjiAI is an enterprise AI call center and sales infrastructure platform based in San Diego, CA.

## Core Solutions

- [Done-For-You AI Call Centers](https://kenjiai.com/call-center-upgrade): Complete Inbound & Outbound telephony. 24/7 autonomous inbound receptionists (<500ms latency), sub-60s automated outbound dialing on new ad leads, database win-back campaigns, natural barge-in interruption handling, dynamic CRM syncing, and direct calendar bookings.
- [DFY Inbound Paid Client Acquisition](https://kenjiai.com/paid-ads-for/home-services): Managed Google Local Services Ads (LSA), Google Search Ads, and Meta Ads engineered to drive high-intent inbound calls directly into automated AI voice agents.
- [Outbound Speed-to-Lead Automation](https://kenjiai.com/marketing-automation): Sub-60-second automated outbound phone calls triggered immediately upon Meta/Google ad form submission to contact prospects during peak intent.
- [Outbound Database Reactivation](https://kenjiai.com/call-center-upgrade): Automated outbound dialing campaigns to re-engage cold leads and past customer lists with compelling offers.
- [Smart CRM & Pipeline Automation](https://kenjiai.com/crm): Two-way integration with GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, Jobber, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clio.
- [Free Business AI Tools](https://kenjiai.com/free-tools): High-utility tools including Missed Call Revenue Calculator, AI Prompt Generator, PR Pro, and Sales Coach AI.

## Target Industries & High-Ticket Use Cases

- **Emergency Home Services:** Commercial & Residential HVAC, Emergency Plumbing, Roofing, Water Damage Restoration. Instant 24/7 emergency dispatch and after-hours call capture.
- **Medical Spas & Aesthetic Clinics:** Plastic surgery, cosmetic dermatology, medical spas, and dental implants. Sub-minute consultation bookings and after-hours inquiry handling.
- **High-Stakes Legal Intake:** Personal injury, mass tort, and criminal defense law firms capturing urgent claimants before they reach competing attorneys.
- **Commercial Lending & MCA:** Merchant cash advance, equipment financing, and commercial loans requiring real-time qualification.

## Technical Specifications & Telephony Stack

- **Voice Latency:** Sub-500ms end-to-end response latency.
- **Conversational Intelligence:** Natural interruption and speech barge-in support.
- **Telephony Infrastructure:** Direct SIP trunking, WebRTC fallback, STIR/SHAKEN certified caller ID, and carrier compliance.
- **Regulatory Compliance:** Full TCPA compliance, HIPAA-compliant encryption standards, and automated call recording with explicit consent prompts.
- **CRM Syncing:** Direct webhooks, native GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, Jobber, Clio, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, Make.
